title: DaakBaksher Gaan — 2D Sumi-e Wind Game

semver.schema_rule: vX.Y.Z — X: Feature Addition, Y: Bug Fix, Z: Additional

changelog.summary: Full Saul Bass constructivist linocut visual redesign matching official poster (Option 3), pure dark mode palette with high-contrast toggle, proportional responsive physics engine, angular papercut wave horizon, and Option 1 origami folded envelope word slips with unified bilingual typography.
X_feature_additions: Saul Bass Constructivist Redesign: Complete visual overhaul matching official poster (ABHIKISM_VISUAL_PosterOpt3DaakBaksherGaanSaulBass_v2.0_20261013_FINAL.jpg) featuring inky void black (#0E0F12), Saul Bass crimson (#C7242B), aged woodblock cream (#F5EFE1), and warm ochre (#E5CF98)
Linocut Victorian Pillar Postbox: Authentic Saul Bass silhouette with faceted dome cap, dentil trim collar, cream contour linocut outline (#F5EFE1), glowing letter cavity, and center enamel plaque
Angular Horizon Waves: Multi-layered constructivist papercut wave silhouettes (#E5CF98 ochre, #C7242B crimson, and #0E0F12 inky silhouette with cream crest trim) anchoring the stage baseline
Origami Folded Envelopes: Option 1 geometric folded cream paper slips with triangular fold flap, diagonal creases, and crimson corner fold accent
Unified Bilingual Typography: Identical layout for both song words and decoy words (bold Bengali script + uppercase English romanization, zero decoy labeling)
Saul Bass Dark Mode & High-Contrast Toggle: Permanent dark aesthetic with one-click toggle (#btn-theme-toggle) between Classic Saul Bass Noir and High-Contrast Graphic Noir
Y_bug_fixes: Eliminated awkward window resize jumping by removing abrupt (entity.x / prevW) * stageWidth coordinate recalculations and transitioning to smooth normalized vertical lane distribution (laneRatio)
Implemented proportional postbox scaling using CSS clamp() (clamp(140px, 16vw, 195px)) to prevent collision with top HUD on small viewports
Removed redundant single-script romanisation toggle button in favor of unified bilingual origami envelopes
Z_additional: Added v7.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill, updated version badges across HUD and certificate canvas, and comprehensive test suite validation for v7.0.0

changelog.summary: Fixed broken canonical streaming links (verified Spotify track 5ZrfaZ8vM5pXGJaee4NKW1 & YouTube Music track mPZvSvhKr88) and eliminated mobile tab reload/crash triggers (throttled 60 FPS postMessage IPC to 250ms interval, removed top-navigation sandbox vulnerability, and removed getElementById monkey-patching).
Y_bug_fixes: Replaced placeholder/search DSP links with verified canonical URLs: Spotify (5ZrfaZ8vM5pXGJaee4NKW1), YouTube Music (mPZvSvhKr88), and YouTube Video (mPZvSvhKr88) across game dock, embed tray, and onelink discography
Eliminated 60 FPS postMessage IPC flooding in requestAnimationFrame by moving syncYouTubeTelemetryTick to a throttled 250ms interval active only during YouTube playback
Removed allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation sandbox permission from Apple Music embed iframe to prevent accidental top-level mobile page navigation and reloads
Removed global document.getElementById monkey-patching to restore native DOM lookup performance in mobile WebKit/Blink
Z_additional: Added v6.1.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and updated all test suite assertions to v6.1.0 with canonical DSP track verification

changelog.summary: Level-based wrong word penalty progression (0%, 20%, 100%, 200%, 500%), time-scaled speed scoring (round((Raw Score / Seconds) * 100)), tightened authentic Hanko fingerprint seal, wax dot mark removal from envelope slips, username placeholder cleanup, authenticated-only version registry, and arcade portal launch for games.abhikism.com.
X_feature_additions: Level-based wrong word penalties: Level 1 (0%), Level 2 (20% = 20 pts), Level 3 (100% = 100 pts), Level 4 (200% = 200 pts), Level 5 (500% = 500 pts)
Arcade Speed Index scoring: Final Score = round((Raw Score / Elapsed Seconds) * 100), massively rewarding fast completions
Launched games.abhikism.com Arcade Hub featuring Daakbaksher Gaan as the featured #1 game with level badges and direct play link
Y_bug_fixes: Tightened authentic Hanko double square frame (156px) around the #ABHIKISM fingerprint seal on the 9:16 certificate
Removed wax seal dot mark from floating word envelope flaps for clean vector paper folds
Changed username input placeholder to 'e.g. username' (replacing 'e.g. abhik_listener')
Gated Semantic Versioning Registry so it is only visible to logged-in users inside the Leaderboard modal
Z_additional: Added v6.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and comprehensive automated test suite coverage for penalty progression and speed scoring

changelog.summary: UI refinements for Daakbaksher Gaan (postbox plaque cleaned up with centered percentage indicator, envelope-shaped floating word slips with postal flap styling), user self-service data viewing and soft-deletion portal (user.abhikism.com), and privacy hardening.
X_feature_additions: Official #ABHIKISM fingerprint Hanko seal stamped on 9:16 Certificate of Authenticity
User self-service data viewing and soft-deletion portal deployed at user.abhikism.com with active view filtering
Envelope-shaped floating word slips with postal flap styling and WCAG touch compliance
Y_bug_fixes: Postbox plaque cleaned up: removed 'abhikism' and 'daakbaksho' text, centered completion percentage indicator
Z_additional: Added v5.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and extended 9-test automated test suite

changelog.summary: Fixed 0% completeness certificate bug by removing the 0 || targetWords fallback and strictly gating the 9:16 certificate preview, issue button, download button, and HUD certificate button behind 100% postbox completeness.
Y_bug_fixes: Fixed 0% completeness bug where 0 collected words fell back to targetWords (0 || 5 -> 5) and rendered a fake 100% Complete certificate preview

Added syncCertificateCompletionGate() to hide the HUD 9:16 Certificate button (#btn-open-certificate), certificate canvas frame (.cert-canvas-frame), issue button (#btn-generate-cert), and download button (#btn-download-cert) whenever postbox completeness is below 100%

Added locked certificate state card (#cert-incomplete-lock-card) in the modal when opened via Account Login at <100% completeness, and added hard guard in downloadCertificate9x16() and backend API against <100% completeness
Z_additional: Added v4.1.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and headless Chrome assertions for 0% vs 100% completeness certificate gating

changelog.summary: Added Username + Created Password Authentication gating social media profile links, voluntary personal info, and Leaderboard visibility; implemented mobile UI touch/viewport fixes (6-word compact density, 44px touch targets, single-row landscape dock) and Zero-Client-Exposure privacy hardening.
X_feature_additions: Username + Created Password authentication system (registerUserAccount, loginUserAccount, submitUserAuth, logoutUserAccount) with salted SHA-256 / PBKDF2 password hashing
Authenticated access gate for entering social media links (#cert-step1-box) and voluntary personal info (#cert-step2-voluntary-box) in the 9:16 Certificate modal
Members-only Official Leaderboard gate (#leaderboard-auth-gate & /api/game-leaderboard) visible exclusively to logged-in users while displaying verified names and social profiles
Y_bug_fixes: Fixed mobile touch drag responsiveness with cached stage bounds, explicit releasePointerCapture, touch-action: none, and WCAG 44px touch targets

Implemented Option A adaptive word density (6 concurrent words on compact mobile <=420px wide or <=480px tall, 10 on desktop/tablet) and clamped initial mobile spawn X inside visible bounds away from the postbox
Fixed 844x390 landscape dock collision, 340x640 Completeness cell clipping, duplicate mobile HUD audio buttons, and repositioned #feedback-whisper to top of stage
Remediated client bundle privacy by stripping all internal notification email addresses, third-party relay tokens, and cloud document IDs from client HTML/JS and API responses
Z_additional: Added v4.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill, top HUD account status button (#btn-user-auth), and honeypot anti-spam protection

changelog.summary: Fixed backend notification links by binding canonical public URLs (https://songs.abhikism.com/daakbaksher-gaan/game/), blocking local loopback Referer leakage, and adding server-side relay synchronization.
Y_bug_fixes: Fixed broken local loopback link in notification dispatches by setting canonical game URLs (https://songs.abhikism.com/daakbaksher-gaan/game/) and blocking direct browser calls from 127.0.0.1/localhost/file:
Added server-side authenticated notification relay and cloud sync so notifications arrive reliably
Z_additional: Added v3.1.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and clickable game_url / leaderboard_url links inside notification payloads

changelog.summary: YouTube Music embedded player looping by default with smart error detection fallback to Instant Web Audio, continuous autoplay by default, and exclusive Mute/Unmute + Play from Beginning (0:00) controls (zero Stop/Pause).
X_feature_additions: YouTube Music embedded player (8K1B2qG3U7E) active and looping by default via YouTube IFrame API with automatic loop-on-end and auto-resume-on-pause enforcement

Smart audio error detection (smartDetectAudioErrorAndFallback / window.triggerSmartAudioErrorFallback) detecting YT.Player onError events, iframe API script blocks, offline states, and watchdog timeouts to seamlessly switch to Instant Web Audio fallback (daakbaksher-gaan.m4a)
Continuous default song playback with only Mute/Unmute (#btn-mute-toggle, #btn-dock-mute) and Play from Beginning 0:00 (#btn-restart-song, #btn-dock-restart) options and zero Stop/Pause controls
Y_bug_fixes: Prevented dual-audio track overlap by keeping Instant Web Audio fallback silenced while YouTube Music primary loop is active
Added transparent click-shield over embedded YouTube surface and pause-interception guard on fallback Web Audio so playback can never be stopped
Z_additional: Added v3.0.0 Leaderboard version filter pill and updated version_manifest.json across all 14 deployment targets

changelog.summary: 5 automatic wind levels (5->15->25->50->125 words), live HUD & certificate timer, official Leaderboard with version/level/timing tags, and Completeness telemetry.
X_feature_additions: 5-level automatic progression system (5 -> 15 -> 25 -> 50 -> 125 target words) with automatic windspeed scaling (1.0x -> 1.35x -> 1.75x -> 2.20x -> 2.75x) and zero manual controls
Live high-precision game timer (#hud-timer, MM:SS.d) displayed in HUD and stamped on the 9:16 Story Certificate
Leaderboard system (#leaderboard-modal & /api/game-leaderboard) with version winner tags, timing tags, and level info tags
Mandatory semantic game versioning (vX.Y.Z) enforced at build time and displayed across HUD, 9:16 Certificate, Leaderboard, and server telemetry
Y_bug_fixes: Unified all progress UI and certificate wording around Complete / Completeness
Cleaned up track metadata badges across game HUD, player dock, 9:16 certificate canvas, and arcade hub
Enforced level-completion gate on advanceToNextLevel() and certificate issuance so levels and wind speeds cannot be manually skipped
Added visibilitychange timer pause/resume lifecycle and fresh elapsed-time snapshot on final word drop
Unified Leaderboard ranking comparator (Level DESC, Score DESC, Fastest Time ASC, Timestamp ASC, CertID ASC) and HTML-escaped player fields
Z_additional: Added level-advance workflow in completion modal and seeded canonical leaderboard winners across versions

changelog.summary: Initial 2D Sumi-e wind game with 125 canonical song words, 250 decoy words, Bengali <-> Roman toggle, and 9:16 certificate.
X_feature_additions: Initial 2D Sumi-e wind game with 125 canonical song words and 250 decoy words
Bengali <-> Roman Bengali live script toggle and 9:16 listener certificate with multi-platform social handle validation
